summary: App polish work before publishing: implement a single global style for loading/error states and apply UI spacing/consistency improvements across the entire app.
architectural_notes: Introduce shared/global UI components/styles for loading indicators and error messaging to ensure consistency across all screens.

existing_features.title: Create a single, reusable global UI pattern for loading states (spinner/skeleton + message) and apply it consistently across the app screens, replacing ad-hoc loading UI (e.g., AuthGate full-screen loader and page-level loaders such as LeaderboardPage).

Create a single, reusable global UI pattern for error states (icon/title/message + optional retry action) and apply it consistently across the app screens and data-fetching components, replacing ad-hoc error messages (e.g., inline destructive text blocks) with the global pattern.

Perform an app-wide UI spacing and consistency pass across all pages and common layouts to achieve a more polished, uniform look (headers, max-width containers, section spacing, card padding, and button alignment), while keeping existing functionality unchanged.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement a single global loading and error message style used across the entire app
Review and update UI spacing and consistency across the entire app for a more polished feel

projectName: Add global loading/error UI components and apply spacing/consistency polish across the app
